text: Adding a second dependency on top of the provisional one.

argv:
cat > app/pnpm-lock.yaml <<'EOF'
lockfileVersion: '9.0'

settings:
  autoInstallPeers: true
  excludeLinksFromLockfile: false

importers:

  .:
    dependencies:
      '@helmwright/fx-duration':
        specifier: file:vendor/fx-duration
        version: file:vendor/fx-duration
      '@helmwright/fx-duration-alias':
        specifier: file:vendor/fx-duration
        version: file:vendor/fx-duration

packages:

  '@helmwright/fx-duration@file:vendor/fx-duration':
    resolution: {directory: vendor/fx-duration, type: directory}

snapshots:

  '@helmwright/fx-duration@file:vendor/fx-duration': {}
EOF
